report.summary: The investigation identified a certificate expiry issue in the payments service as the root cause of the elevated error rate in the orders service. Logs from the orders service (LOG-00676, LOG-00678, LOG-00687, LOG-00695) explicitly reference TLS handshake failures and certificate expiry when communicating with the payments service. The dependency structure (DEP-004) confirms the direct interaction between orders and payments, reinforcing the hypothesis.
report.uncertainty: The absence of ERROR-level logs in payments about certificate expiry introduces some uncertainty, but WARN-level logs and orders service logs strongly support the hypothesis.
